parameters_order: [declared central K, declared independent positive-tail count, declared physical profile count]; no variable T
radial_interpolation: Exact continuous P1 binary-node corrections in physical s=x
node_derivative: One-sided cell slope; side affects no value or angular derivative

physical_profile.derivative_formula: Leibniz factored polynomial, derivatives 0..4 vanish at support endpoints
physical_profile.radial_clock: s is physical; scale 1; no warp

angular_chart: R149 explicit global frozen ruling atlas; saved blend is only the unchanged original-chart component

central_definition.material_map: u(phi)=integral_0^phi rho_seed/a0; same fixed map for every d and both base kinds

lifting.radial_weights: quintic steps; complete central and tail functions, no angular truncation
lifting.seed_weight: 1-S5((s-start)/(end-start)), clipped to 1/0 outside the saved interval

actual_map: R119/R124 fixed physical u; F_s=F*A, X_s=F*e1; 24 body/angle-variation components

coast_reference_provenance.scalar_constants: SavedNativeCoast stored numeric representatives, bound by the R139 positivity packet
coast_reference_provenance.native_formula: R139 at sigma=s-entry_s and the actual fixed material u
coast_reference_provenance.exact_GC_metric_scope: Only the frozen K=0 coast with a(s)=a_c+v*(s-entry_s); changed physical-bump g uses this as reference only
coast_reference_provenance.cache_key: s.hex plus canonical full actual u column; actual column equality checked on every hit

reference_second_jet_evaluator.formula: Original R139 values/first jets at the known ruling label, with analytic finite-inlet third derivatives

actual_complete_field: Full saved affine P1/lifting/atlas, then declared coast R153, then disjoint terminal R155

angular_atlas_definition.coast_formula: Frozen R139 ruling map, label xi is fixed inlet seed-normal angle
angular_atlas_definition.coordinate_metric: (1+a_delta^2 U_s^2) ds^2+2 a_delta^2 U_s U_xi ds dxi+a_delta^2 U_xi^2 dxi^2
angular_atlas_definition.elsewhere: original chart on open central and cut neighborhoods
angular_atlas_definition.field_interface: shared P1 coefficient value and common full physical lifting trace; U_s continuity is not assumed
angular_atlas_definition.interface_radial_jets: one-sided; coordinates side=coast default, or left/right explicitly
angular_atlas_definition.interface_values_and_angular_jets: same whole functions on both sides

original_chart.intended_actual_map: Reconstruct at fixed material u after inverting xi(s,u); use the original skew radial frame ODE.

angular_atlas_definition.positive_U_xi: positive convex combinations of original/seed/frozen-exit derivatives, and R139 D>0 within coast

checkpoint_reference_evaluation_definiti.cache: bounded recent 64 scalar-s/full-label pairs, actual label equality and requested material composition checked
checkpoint_reference_evaluation_definiti.method: R139 native_from_inlet at known frozen inlet label; no material inverse

checkpoint_finite_radial_scheme: Exact affine lifting endpoints plus Gauss2 physical PDE with complete nonlinear Gauss-l correction
coast_label: Frozen inlet seed-normal xi; incoming material t=U_seed(xi)
native_interface_side: side=left or right applies jointly to actual P1 slope and actual chart radial jets; default right
chart_only_default_side: coast, matching the finite solver convention

gauss_l_definition.exact_elimination_reason: entire nodal P1 hat support lies in w=1, so (1-w)*hat is identically zero
gauss_l_definition.exact_pointwise_domain: n>0 at every point with w>0; no positivity condition imposed at the flat n=0 tail
gauss_l_definition.n_and_m: unchanged complete affine P1 correction plus exact declared lifting
gauss_l_definition.regularity_sufficient_domain: uniform n>=nu>0 on a neighborhood of the closed coast support, as in R153
gauss_l_definition.weight: same S5 coast-window function as the declared frozen reference

actual_shape_denominator: Original coast n in its declared positive domain; terminal h only at active non-cut interior points

jet_requirements.values_and_angular_first_second: Actual K and full native n/m angular jets; no K_s
jet_requirements.radial_and_mixed: Actual one-sided K_s for the coast and terminal interiors only; exact cut radial II jets are not assigned
jet_requirements.base_a_sss: Actual Hermite polynomial third derivative, or cos(phase)*phase_ss-sin(phase)*phase_s^2
jet_requirements.bump_a_sss: Sum of actual saved delta_j times compact basis third derivative
jet_requirements.outside_window: Outside both declared windows original actual jets are retained; no profile third derivative is queried by the terminal map there

actual_body_consumer: Existing fixed-material 24-column formula, using physical_angular only; no radial II endpoint jet requested and no body solve performed here

positive_trace_definition.composition_order: R153 coast positive-n Gauss-l first, then disjoint R155 terminal positive trace
positive_trace_definition.exact_tail_bypass: At s=cut take E=E_xi=all E parameter/state partials=0 along the accurate analytic nonnegative tail family
positive_trace_definition.exact_trace_gauge: At entire-hat plateau nodes set raw n correction=(old n-old l)/2, raw l correction=negative of it; d unchanged
positive_trace_definition.invariant_fields: d=n-l and m from the actual R153 background
positive_trace_definition.positive_K_domain: K>=0 at active non-cut points; h>0 when its general derivative is used; no n floor added
positive_trace_definition.tail_contract: All correction coefficients at cut are exactly zero; existing positive tail parameters define the complete true trace
positive_trace_definition.weight: S5((s-start)/(ramp_stop-start)), clipped, then exactly one up to cut

terminal_cut_jet_scope.actual_cut_values_and_angular_first_seco: Original accurate nonnegative tail directly; increment is identically zero as an angular trace function
terminal_cut_jet_scope.radial_and_mixed_cut_jets: Not assigned by this reader; no assertion E_s=0 or general square-root differentiability at h=0
terminal_cut_jet_scope.interior_radial_and_mixed: Complete quotient/product formulas with actual piecewise K_s

angular_embedding_definition.complete_field_preservation: Raw/central exact zero injection, same finite degree tail, same metric/atlas/full lifting, then the same pointwise nonlinear maps

independent_layout_scope: Any finite actual coefficients with this exact declared layout and unchanged full function definitions; not limited to zero padding
